rationale: Melbourne land-development civil consultancy that invites recruitment contact and graduate EOIs when no vacancy is listed.
Civil engineering, drafting and land development overlap Advanced Diploma coursework; Melton to CBD is a realistic commute.
Published recruitment@reedsconsulting.com.au on the contact page for recruitment enquiries.
apply_instructions: Email CV and cover letter to recruitment@reedsconsulting.com.au (Contact page Recruitment section). Careers page also has an EOI form for Graduate Work Experience.
title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
company_work_evidence: Reeds Consulting careers and contact pages list Melbourne Swanston Street and Hallam offices; services include civil engineering, land surveying, town planning and development consulting; leadership lists Haydon Day Director Engineering and Frank Mendolia Director Infrastructure and Design; careers page states no vacancies and invites EOI and Graduate Work Experience.
